chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.why: Signs in through Codex's own sign-in. OpenAI documents it for Codex, not for other apps, and has endorsed one other app using it.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.why: Documented sign-in for any app, no registration. Pay-as-you-go credits, not a subscription.

grok.name: Grok
grok.why: xAI allows plan sign-in only in apps it has partnered with.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
copilot.why: GitHub allows Copilot sign-in only in apps it has partnered with; this uses VS Code's client.
